data.evidence_sentence: Awarded annually on the basis of academic achievement to an outstanding female student, who is Canadian citizen and an Alberta resident, registered full-time.
data.notes: Page lists no application deadline and no award amount or funding type. Term is Spring/Summer. Nominee must be in first year of MBA; scholarship granted for two years subject to review after first year (renewal criteria not specified). Academic excellence required but no numeric GPA stated; 'academically outstanding' is a selection basis, not a verbal grade threshold. Eligibility text says 'Canadian citizen' so nationality is ONLY:Canada. Enrollment status set to enrolled because the nominee must be registered full-time in the MBA program.
